assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, green-ratio, and setback controls are not in the public site package; all intensity language in this proposal is a design suggestion, not a statutory control.
assumptions.impact: Proposal is reviewable as an AI concept-design submission; statutory controls need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional (repository-provided). They are used only for generation, display, and intake self-check.
assumptions.impact: All areas and ratios must be recalculated when official polygons are published; no official-redline claim is made.

assumptions.statement: land_use.geojson partitions the provisional boundary into concept zones using MNR land-use codes; it is a design proposal, not an approved regulatory land-use plan.
assumptions.impact: Land-use statements are directional suggestions for professional teams to deepen.

assumptions.statement: building_footprint.geojson footprints are schematic design blocks generated to test intensity and massing logic, not survey-grade buildings or demolition/renovation conclusions.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level build/retain/demolish commitment is made.

assumptions.statement: roads.geojson is a conceptual network skeleton for connectivity logic; alignments are not road redlines and require official road data.
assumptions.impact: No engineering alignment claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Existing rail/metro lines in constraints.geojson are indicative schematic alignments from public knowledge for context only.
assumptions.impact: No track alignment claim is made.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards, personas, events, and operations are concept suggestions subject to privacy review, human-in-the-loop review, and licensing; none are confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Scenarios are open material for professional and community deepening.

assumptions.statement: Only public, repository-provided, or user-cleared data was used; no non-public, personal, or confidential material is included.
